# Speech-MCP (Multi-Provider Speech Gateway)

![Status: Active](https://img.shields.io/badge/Status-Active-green?style=for-the-badge)
![FastMCP: 3.4](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastMCP-3.4-blue?style=for-the-badge)
![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green?style=for-the-badge)

Multi-provider speech gateway (MCP server + React webapp): **FunASR local STT**
(multilingual, incl. EN/JA/DE), **sherpa-onnx streaming STT with barge-in**
(ja/en/de, CPU), Gemini Live/TTS, Hume AI (EVI/Octave), ElevenLabs TTS + voice
cloning, offline wake word, RAG over speech docs, and a fleet voice command bus.

> Version 0.6.4. Deep docs: `docs/` (STT, streaming, configuration,
> troubleshooting, humanoid/fleet architecture).

## Architecture

```
FastMCP stdio server  <-->  Claude Desktop / MCP clients
       |
FastAPI REST :10909  <-->  React/Vite frontend :10908
       |
MCP SSE :10909/mcp   <-->  Bridge target for ProxyProvider
       |
Providers (via .env)
  |- FunASR MLT-Nano-2512  local STT (torch, GPU/CPU) or sidecar :10914
  |- sherpa-onnx            streaming STT + barge-in (ja/en/de, CPU)
  |- Gemini 3.1             TTS + STT + Live (GOOGLE_API_KEY)
  |- Hume AI                EVI + Octave (HUME_API_KEY)
  |- ElevenLabs             TTS + cloning (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY)
  |- Gemma 4                local (SAPI5 fallback)
  |- Windows SAPI5          always-available TTS
       |
LanceDB (RAG)  <-  data/lancedb/
openWakeWord   <-  offline wake word
```

## Ports

| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 10908 | Frontend (Vite dev) |
| 10909 | Backend (FastAPI + MCP SSE `/mcp`, WebSocket `/ws/stream`, `/ws/stt`, `/ws/logs`) |
| 10914 | FunASR OpenAI-compatible sidecar (optional, `scripts/start_funasr_sidecar.py`) |

## MCP Tools (26)

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `text_to_speech` | TTS across windows / gemini / hume / elevenlabs / gemma |
| `text_to_dialogue` | Multi-voice dialogue (ElevenLabs) |
| `manage_voice_clones` | List / clone / delete ElevenLabs voices |
| `transcribe_audio_file` | Batch STT (default `funasr`) |
| `transcribe_stream_chunk` | Stateless chunk/base64 STT |
| `streaming_stt` | Streaming STT (sherpa-onnx, ja/en/de): feed PCM, partials + endpoint |
| `barge_in_feed` | Feed mic audio; returns completed utterances = barge-in signal |
| `start_evi_session` | Hume EVI realtime session |
| `detect_wake_word` | Gemini Live VAD arming |
| `configure_local_wake_word` | openWakeWord start/stop/status (offline) |
| `agentic_conversation_workflow` | Agentic mission via ctx.sample/elicit |
| `orchestrate_alexa_pattern` | Alexa-style proactive loop |
| `manage_domestic_utility` | Timers / weather (wttr.in) / alarms |
| `trigger_action` | Declared IoT bridge stub (no fake success) |
| `search_docs` / `ask_docs` | LanceDB RAG search + grounded Q&A |
| `safety_validate_intent` / `safety_verify_auth` / `safety_log_audit` | Safety layer |
| `prosody_dashboard` / `speech_activity_chart` / `fleet_health_overview` / `provider_capability_matrix` / `latency_benchmark_view` | Prefab UI cards (real data) |
| `play_audio_file` / `run_speech_demo` | Diagnostics |

REST surface: `/api/v1/health`, `/api/v1/status`, `/api/health`, `/api/capabilities`,
`/api/tools`, `/api/v1/diagnostics`, `/api/v1/tts`, `/api/v1/tts/wav`,
`/api/v1/voices`, `/api/v1/voices/clone`, `/api/v1/transcribe`,
`/api/v1/wake_word`, `/api/v1/utility`, `/api/v1/agentic`, `/api/v1/action`,
`/api/v1/stop`, `/api/v1/shutdown`, `/api/v1/history`, `/api/v1/search`,
`/api/v1/stats`, `/api/v1/local/models`, `/api/v1/hardware`, `/api/v1/demos/run`.

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|----------|---------|---------|
| `SPEECH_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` | — | Optional bearer token for REST (`X-Speech-MCP-Auth`) |
| `SPEECH_MCP_PORT` | 10909 | Backend port |
| `FUNASR_ENABLED` | false | Enable native FunASR (`uv sync --extra funasr`) |
| `FUNASR_MODEL` | `FunAudioLLM/Fun-ASR-MLT-Nano-2512` | Hub model (multilingual, EN/JA/DE) |
| `FUNASR_DEVICE` | cuda:0 | cuda:0 or cpu |
| `FUNASR_HUB` | hf | hf or ms (ModelScope) |
| `FUNASR_OPENAI_URL` | — | Use OpenAI-compatible sidecar instead of native torch |
| `SHERPA_ASR_ENABLED` | false | Enable sherpa-onnx streaming STT (`uv sync --extra sherpa`) |
| `SHERPA_ASR_LANG` | en | en \| ja \| de (streaming model) |
| `SHERPA_BARGE_IN` | false | Endpoint-based barge-in (interrupt while assistant speaks) |
| `SHERPA_MODEL_DIR` | models/sherpa-onnx | Local model download dir |
| `SHERPA_NUM_THREADS` | 2 | onnxruntime threads |
| `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | — | Gemini TTS/STT/Live |
| `HUME_API_KEY` | — | Hume EVI / Octave |
| `HUME_CONFIG_ID` | — | Default EVI config |
| `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` | — | ElevenLabs TTS / cloning |
| `FLEET_VOICE_DELEGATE` / `FLEET_VOICE_ROUTER_URL` / `FLEET_VOICE_WAKE_KEYWORD` / `FLEET_VOICE_AUTOSTART` / `FLEET_VOICE_COMMAND_SECONDS` / `FLEET_VOICE_SPEAK_REPLY` / `FLEET_VOICE_WAKE_GREETING` / `FLEET_VOICE_SLEEP_KEYWORD` | — | Fleet voice command bus (wake -> STT -> fleet-agent) |
| `MCP_BRIDGE_URLS` | — | Comma-separated SSE URLs to proxy as MCP tools |
| `SPEECH_TAURI` | — | Tauri desktop flag (CORS) |

## Setup

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/speech-mcp
cd speech-mcp
uv sync --extra funasr            # local STT
uv run python scripts/download_sherpa_models.py   # streaming STT (en/ja/de)
Copy-Item .env.example .env       # fill keys
just start                        # backend 10909 + frontend 10908
```

For Claude Desktop MCP: see `docs/configuration.md`. Windows app: `just build-native`
(Tauri/NSIS). Claude Desktop bundle: `just mcpb-pack`.

## Streaming STT & barge-in (sherpa-onnx)

- Streaming online ASR (ja/en/de) on CPU with partial results + endpoint detection.
- Barge-in: feed mic via `barge_in_feed`; a completed utterance = interrupt signal.
- Voice listener `SHERPA_ASR_ENABLED=1` uses streaming capture (no fixed command
  window) with a follow-up turn loop.
- Full guide + model table: `docs/STREAMING_ASR.md`.
